# Archival Dispatch: 16 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Radio Pioneer Biographies and Kaliman: El Hombre Increíble

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: Radio Biographies, Norman Corwin, Damon Runyon, Dale Evans, Hopalong Cassidy, Kaliman, Radionovelas, Original Filenames

---

## Batch 39 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 39 resolves 16 historical biographical and dramatic serial broadcasts: 8 documentary profiles of legendary Golden Age broadcasters and actors from ***Audio Files: Radio Biographies*** (1978–1979, featuring writer-director Norman Corwin, Damon Runyon, Dale Evans, Hopalong Cassidy's William Boyd, and Irene Dunne), and 8 high-suspense episodes of Latin America's most legendary dramatic radio adventure serial, ***Kaliman: El Hombre Increíble*** (1966–1969, across four complete serial sagas: *Los Lobos Humanos*, *El Valle de los Vampiros*, *Los Misterios de Bonampak*, and *El Juego de la Muerte*).

---
